_comment: Entries that the upstream pipeline in data/ does not produce, because they describe ATLAS itself, and curated enrichments (curatedPrograms, curatedCountries, curatedCategory, note) applied additively to repositories the source already provides. Merged by scripts/extract-catalog.mjs on every run, so they survive a regeneration of data/catalog.js. Same shape as that file. Every value here is observed, not estimated.

projects.name: ATLAS
projects.description: An open observatory for discovering projects and repositories across the Stellar ecosystem. Turns a public directory into a catalog you can browse by program, category, language and builder.

repositories.note: Proyecto fundado en Chile por Bruno Miranda (Universidad Tecnológica Metropolitana de Chile), confirmado por el fundador en su nota del blog de Tellus del 2026-06-08. Su build de Stellar Hack+ Buenos Aires 2025 queda como participación en un evento distinto.

builders.note: Owner of the repository. ATLAS is built and maintained by Tellus Cooperative.
